ei.title: The Selective Nature of Individual Evolution
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: For evolution to work, selection needs to be — as the term suggests — selective. This means that selection needs to be based on an individual life form's properties and not on a whole population of life forms. It is not enough that a change improves the ability for a life form to survive. It needs to improve the life form's likelihood of survival relative to other life forms. For example, if a life form has a mutation that produces chemicals that speed up the process of procreation but distributes these chemicals among all other life forms, every life form nearby profits, no matter whether they had the beneficial mutation or not. This is similar to the situation in an economy. Money, status, or reputation is given preferably to those people and companies that have methods more adapted to the environment (the market). A well-run restaurant with better service will attract more customers than a poorly run restaurant. If, at the end of the day, the better restaurant had to share its earnings with all other restaurants, it might have a harder time "evolving" and expanding its business.

This is similar to the situation in an economy. Money, status, or reputation is given preferably to those people and companies that have methods more adapted to the environment (the market). A well-run restaurant with better service will attract more customers than a poorly run restaurant. If, at the end of the day, the better restaurant had to share its earnings with all other restaurants, it might have a harder time "evolving" and expanding its business.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ improve → improves (단수 주어 3인칭 현재)
det.analysis:
① selective: needs to be selective — be 뒤 형용사 보어로 적절
② not: not on a whole population — 부정 부사로 적절
③ improve: 주어 a change는 단수이므로 3인칭 단수 현재형 improves가 필요. improve는 어법상 틀림 ←정답
④ relative: relative to other life forms — 전치사구 수식 형용사로 적절
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 현재: a change improves (단수 주어 + -s)

det.korean: ③ no matter that → no matter whether (양보절 접속사)
det.analysis:
① produces: a mutation that produces chemicals — 관계대명사절 내 단수 동사 적절

det.tip: no matter whether(~인지 아닌지) vs no matter that(×, 존재하지 않는 표현)

det.korean: ③ impossibility → likelihood (가능성)

④ beneficial: 유익한 돌연변이 → 적절
det.tip: likelihood(가능성) ↔ impossibility(불가능성)

det.korean: ② competes → profits (이득을 얻다)
det.analysis:
① speed up: 번식 과정을 가속하는 화학물질 생산 → 적절
② competes: 돌연변이 화학물질이 배포되면 주변 생명체가 '이득을 얻어야'(profits) 함. '경쟁하다'(competes)는 문맥상 부적절 ←정답
③ adapted: 환경에 적응된 방법을 가진 기업 → 적절
④ earnings: 더 나은 레스토랑의 수익을 나누어야 한다 → 적절
det.tip: profits(이득을 얻다) ↔ competes(경쟁하다) — 공유 상황에서 '이득'이 핵심

det.korean: 선택이 '개별 생명체의 특성에 근거'해야 한다는 조건

det.korean: ④ 수익 공유 시 확장 어렵다 → 원문 일치
